executive_summary: S08.2 answered "I meant the people, not the weather." with the host template "I don't have an unexecuted intention to revise. What do you want to change?" The earliest demonstrated incorrect decision is `_pending_revision_decision` in `game/conversational_orchestration.py`: `_REVISION_RE` matches `i meant`, no pending or executed intention existed, and the function returned reason `no_pending_intention`. The stored purpose `CORRECTION` is written by that return and does not prove the model label. The raw interpretation record was not retained. One live interpretation call ran; narration count was 0; `bind()` did not run. Failure class: contract. Relationship to PR-EG-R6-R5: C, different mechanism. R5 corrections are 0/25 on the full 164-turn corpus (validation subset 0/8). All 25 called `semantic_plan` and heard bind/witness lines. None heard S08.2's sentence. R5 production success is 59/164. Validation is 18/54. I8 is 44/54 and I10B is 45/54 on the validation intervention slice; those are not production forecasts. Restricted hits were 0. R4-R1 remains C and is an integration ban; R5's B grade does not replace it. NEXT_SESSION had not mentioned R5; that was staleness. The justified next pass is a narrower intention-control entry condition that preserves the three PR-EF-R4 revision holdouts. Whether the ordinary answer path would then name the visible people is unproven. No production code, test expectation, frozen baseline, or authority boundary changed. No live provider call was made.
